href.description: Link target for the avatar image.

src.description: Image source URL for the avatar image variant.

alt.description: Accessible label for the avatar. Used as image alt text or initials-link aria-label.

initials.description: Initials text for the initials avatar variant. When provided, image markup is replaced with initials markup.

shape.description: Optional shape utility for avatar image or initials.

tooltip.description: Optional tooltip text displayed on hover.

className.description: Additional classes for the avatar link element.

imageClassName.description: Additional classes for the avatar image element.

initialsClassName.description: Additional classes for the initials element.
